deploy-bot: Starting pipeline for tag v1.8.3-release -> env: staging -> commit: abc1234f
ci-bot: Build started (matrix: linux, mac, windows) :gear:
ci-bot: Build passed on linux, mac. windows still running. :white_check_mark:
ci-bot: Lint step failed on linux: 
```
flake8: tests/models/test_inference.py:42:1: F401 'json' imported but unused
```
ci-bot: Also seeing pytest failure on linux: 
```
E   AssertionError: expected 0 but got 1
  tests/e2e/test_routing.py:87
```
alex: oof lint + test on same job. can we rerun just the lint or do we need a full rebuild?
maria: rerun lint job first, if it still fails we'll pin back the previous commit and hotfix. windows still running, let's wait 60s. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
jamal: my local repro shows an accidental import left behind in the new optimizer shim, i'll prepare a 1-line fix on a hotfix branch.
ci-bot: windows build passed. overall status: build=pass, lint=fail, tests=fail (1 failing e2e).
sre-oncall: change window is open for another 3 hours. If this is a small fix we can do a quick roll-forward patch to avoid rollback.
alex: agree. Jamal, can you push a hotfix branch and cherry-pick patch onto v1.8.3-release tag? We want minimal fallout. :thumbsup:
jamal: pushing hotfix/optimizer-import-fix -> commits: def4567. Cherry-picking into v1.8.3-release: `git checkout -b hotfix/opt-import && git cherry-pick -x def4567`
ci-bot: Received new push to hotfix/optimizer-import-fix. Triggering targeted jobs: lint, linux-e2e.
ci-bot: Lint (hotfix) passed :white_check_mark:
ci-bot: linux-e2e (hotfix) passed :white_check_mark:
deploy-bot: Hotfix applied and build validated. Releasing v1.8.3+hotfix -> staging canary start. :rocket:
maria: pushing canary to 5% first, monitor latency and error rate.
sre-oncall: keeping an eye on error budget and tail latency. notify if 5xx > 0.1% or p99 > 500ms.
alex: tagging release notes: https://redwood-inference.internal/releases/v1.8.3-hotfix (added one-line fix to optimizer shim, no model changes).
maria: rolling from canary -> 25% -> 100% over the next 40 minutes unless we see regressions. :eyes:
ci-bot: Full pipeline status: build=pass, lint=pass, tests=pass after hotfix.
jamal: thanks all — sorry about the stray import. will add a lint rule to catch this.
